note: People born in the Northern Mariana Islands are United States citizens and hold its passport, at its fees.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 48 U.S.C. § 1801 and note, the Covenant to Establish a Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands
sources.said: Section 303. All persons born in the Commonwealth on or after the effective date of this Section and subject to the jurisdiction of the United States will be citizens of the United States at birth.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 22 U.S.C. § 212, Persons entitled to passport
sources.said: No passport shall be granted or issued to or verified for any other persons than those owing allegiance, whether citizens or not, to the United States.
